product.description: Monoprice™Blackbird™ 4K60 2x1 Video Switch with HDMI® Pigtail, Supports HDMI 2.0, HDCP 2.2, HDR, DTS‑HD Master Audio™, and Dolby TrueHD™, BlackConnect Two HDMI Devices to a 4K Display and Easily Switch Between ThemStruggling with too few HDMI® inputs on your display for all your new 4K devices? There's no need for a new TV or a bulky, expensive box. The Blackbird 4K60 2x1 Video Switch with HDMI Pigtail adapter is your simple solution! Just plug this switch into your 4K TV's HDMI input, then connect your HD devices to the switch. That's it! No special setup, no power source, and no remote needed. Just plug and play.This switch features two inputs and supports full 4K60 resolution with HDCP™ pass‑through. It handles up to 12‑bits per channel (36‑bit total) Deep Color and digital audio, including DTS Digital™, DTS‑HD Master Audio™, and Dolby TrueHD™. With a 20‑inch cable and gold‑plated HDMI connectors, it ensures smooth, corrosion‑free connections. The switch automatically toggles between inputs based on which device is active.
